nodes.label: Isolated Effective Validation
nodes.rationale: Hermes validates only an attested executable in a sterile staged environment so live profile secrets and code do not enter child validation.

nodes.label: Recovery Enrollment Boundary
nodes.rationale: Phase-specific recovery methods and roles prevent recovery phrase words from leaking into ordinary desktop and Tauri result surfaces.

nodes.label: V1 Threat Model
nodes.rationale: The system treats cloud storage, harness inputs, packages, and local boundaries as untrusted, while accepting limits of same-user malware and offline device compromise.

nodes.label: Isolated Native Runner and Transaction Engine

Scoped MCP Memory Tasks and Handoffs Design
Supabase Ciphertext Boundary
nodes.rationale: Supabase stores only signed ciphertext and routing metadata; clients retain cryptographic truth and authorization validation.

nodes.label: Session-to-Device Binding
nodes.rationale: Authorization derives account and device solely from authenticated user and JWT session claims, preventing caller-selected identity.

nodes.label: Private Write Services
nodes.rationale: Authenticated clients receive account-scoped read access while authoritative mutations remain behind narrowly granted service wrappers.

nodes.label: Signed Synchronization
nodes.rationale: A local deterministic core encrypts, signs, validates, and reconciles operations before narrow cloud transport adapters are used.

nodes.label: Deterministic Merge
nodes.rationale: Causal dominance and canonical operation-ID ordering make conflict representation independent of physical arrival time.

nodes.label: Cloud Admission Boundary
nodes.rationale: A JWT-protected Edge Function verifies canonical signed envelopes and invokes service-only database procedures before emitting pull hints.

nodes.label: Existing-Device Pairing
nodes.rationale: An active device approves an exact signed request and securely transfers encrypted workspace material to a joining device.

nodes.label: Pairing Grant
nodes.rationale: The grant combines public certificate material with a request-bound encrypted key bundle and requires an independent safety-number comparison.

nodes.label: Pairing Transport Boundary
nodes.rationale: Transport stores bounded public request state and encrypted grants while the Vault remains the authority for local trust decisions.

nodes.label: Fresh-Install Recovery
nodes.rationale: A fresh Vault authenticates a recovery phrase against an exact retained root, then atomically activates a recovered device and material.

nodes.label: Recovery-Device Claim
nodes.rationale: A recovery-root-signed claim is published under provider compare-and-set and then verified by exact lookup before trust activation.

nodes.label: Recovery-Root Enrollment
nodes.rationale: A one-time phrase establishes a recoverable trust root and first-device bootstrap without persisting the phrase or recovery private keys.

nodes.label: Recovery Enrollment Record
nodes.rationale: Canonical signed public root data and encrypted key material are registered by exact-byte compare-and-set, then atomically activated locally.

nodes.label: Native Phrase Confirmation
nodes.rationale: The phrase and permanent confirmation are confined to a trusted native host; renderer and generic IPC routes cannot request them.

nodes.label: Semgrep Package Policy
nodes.rationale: The package policy supplies a scan canary and rejects Python runtime artifacts from native Semgrep packages.

nodes.label: Deterministic Semgrep Source Manifest
nodes.rationale: The manifest defines a reproducible, verified Semgrep corresponding-source bundle and its deferred release qualification.

nodes.label: Endpoint Link Visual Rationale
nodes.rationale: The icon depicts two circular endpoints connected by a horizontal line, visually expressing a relay or transfer between distinct parties.

nodes.label: Connected Endpoints
nodes.rationale: The icon visibly depicts two contrasting circular endpoints joined by a horizontal connector, expressing relay or connection.
